CCT Sri Lanka — Bolgoda fishing ↗
SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Ask which part of the lake system and target apply to your outing. Confirm the gear provision before buying a travel rod, and plan a small waterproof day kit rather than an offshore loadout.

Choose the water and tide plan

Have the skipper identify the actual reach or coastal zone and the intended target. Confirm how boat access and timing fit the trip; do not assume every part of an estuary fishes in the same way. Match terminal tackle only after that choice.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Sri Lanka

Recreational anglers need a licence, including tourists. The tourist fee is charged per day; a boat's registration is a separate requirement.
